name: Pack code transport
summary: Move a project's code between paired computers without GitHub: carried git bundles, a tar fallback, chunked blobs, per-project GitHub account, private publish, and a gh login carry.
description: Code reaches another paired computer by the ladder: git remote clone, then incremental git bundles carried over the Pack link into refs/carnivore/<install>/..., then a one-way tar.zst that includes uncommitted work. An air-gapped project never contacts GitHub. Each project resolves which GitHub account to use, and every gh or git call names it. A gh login can be carried to a paired computer whose owner allowed it.
how_to: POST /api/v1/projects/{name}/sync with a paired computer to carry the project's code.
POST /api/v1/projects/{name}/publish-repo to create a private repo.
examples: Send a commit to another computer with no remote at all.
media_exempt: No screen yet; the cards ship with the P9 UI slice.
